mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_approval (run_id, session_id, step_seq, tool_code, arguments, reason, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{stepSeq}, #{toolCode}, CAST(#{arguments} AS JSON), #{reason}, #{status}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.run_id, a.session_id, a.step_seq, a.tool_code, t.name AS tool_name, a.arguments, a.reason, a.status, a.operator_id, a.operated_at, a.comment, a.expire_at, a.create_time FROM agent_approval a LEFT JOIN agent_tool t ON t.code = a.tool_code WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.run_id, a.session_id, a.step_seq, a.tool_code, t.name AS tool_name, a.arguments, a.reason, a.status, a.operator_id, a.operated_at, a.comment, a.expire_at, a.create_time FROM agent_approval a LEFT JOIN agent_tool t ON t.code = a.tool_code WHERE a.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_approval SET status = #{status}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, comment = #{comment}, operated_at = #{operatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE agent_approval SET status = 'executing' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'approved'
UPDATE agent_approval SET status = 'expired' WHERE status = 'pending' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < #{now}
